page.content:
Unified world title of the Bloodline era.

How Undisputed WWE Championship connects

  • Character: Roman Reigns — Roman Reigns unified and held the Undisputed WWE Championship.
  • Character: John Cena — John Cena's sixteen world-title reigns include later Undisputed-era returns.

What is Undisputed WWE Championship?

The Undisputed WWE Championship is the prize created when Roman Reigns's Universal Title was unified with the WWE Championship, then carried by later champions after his long reign.

Key threads lead to Roman Reigns and John Cena.
